run_GenerateMultiBleuDetokModule: run the GenerateMultiBleuDetokModule to generate BLEU scores for multiple checkpoints and splits
run_fairseq_generate: run fairseq generate to produce translation output from a checkpoint and binarized data
run_multi_bleu_detok_call: run multi-bleu-detok.perl script to calculate BLEU score from fairseq generate output
run_process_output_ref_hyp_file: run process_output_ref_hyp_file to extract reference or hypothesis text from fairseq output
run_get_checkpoint_files_list_from_check: run get_checkpoint_files_list_from_checkpoints_dir to list checkpoint files within an epoch range
